P.name: Dream-Laden Bough
P.title: Template:Data Lillia/Dream-Laden Bough
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dream-Laden Bough|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lillia
|skill        = I
|icon         = Dream-Laden Bough.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Lillia}} abilities apply ''Dream Dust'' to enemies hit, which continually deals {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}} over a short time, and {{tip|heal|heals}} her for the same duration.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lillia's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply ''Dream Dust'' to enemies hit, which deals{{ft|{{as|5% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|'''total''' magic damage}} over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70 to 180}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.|{{as|{{fd|0.8{{Recurring|3}}}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.208{{Recurring|3}}}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70/6 to 180/6}} per tick against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.}}
|description2 = '''Lillia''' {{tip|heals}} herself for{{ft|{{as|39|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6 + ((90-6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}}|{{as|{{ap|39/6}}|heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15/6}}% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6/6 + ((90/6-6/6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6}}% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds}}over the duration of ''Dream Dust'', reduced to 15% effectiveness for each target afflicted beyond the first. She may only heal against 1 monster at a time.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = special
|occurrence   = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|parry        = 
|notes        = 
* ''Dream-Laden Bough'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* {{ais|Lilting Lullaby|Lillia}} application does not apply ''Dream Dust'', but its triggering damage does.
* ''Dream Dust'' is applied even if the target takes no damage from an ability, e.g. by being {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, but not when the ability hit is prevented in the first place (e.g. {{tip|spell shield}}).
}}

Q.name: Blooming Blows
Q.title: Template:Data Lillia/Blooming Blows
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Blooming Blows|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lillia
|skill        = Q
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Prance.png
|blurbicon    = Blooming Blows.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever {{cis|Lillia}} {{tip|abilities}} hit at least one enemy, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Prance'', up to a cap.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' swings her censer around her, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.
|blurb4       = {{sbc|Prance:}} For each stack, '''Lillia''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Lillia's''' {{tip|abilities}} hit at least one enemy, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Prance'' for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|1.5}} seconds when the duration ends.
|description2 = {{sbc|Prance:}} For each stack, '''Lillia''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Movement Speed per Stack|{{ap|3 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|3*4 to 7*4}}% {{as|(+ 12% per 100 AP)}}}}
|icon3        = Blooming Blows.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' swings her censer around her, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 75}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 75*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2}}% AP)}}}}
|description4 = '''''Lillia''' can move during Blooming Blows' cast time.''
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|485|Outer radius}}
|inner radius = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 225
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|6 to 4}}
|cost         = 65
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|damagetype   = Magic True
|spelleffects = aoe
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = true
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent '''Lillia''' from gaining a ''Prance'' stack.
* For the purpose of aim-assist, '''Lillia's''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}} is reduced{{ft|to 275|by 50}}during ''Blooming Blows's'' cast time.
}}

E.name: Swirlseed
E.title: Template:Data Lillia/Swirlseed
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Swirlseed|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lillia
|skill        = E
|icon         = Swirlseed.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lillia}} lobs a seed at the target area that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for a short time.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' lobs a seed at the target location that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 3 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = 12
|cast time    = {{fd|0.4}}
|cost         = 70
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|700|Lob range}}|{{tt|Global|Roll missile range}}}}
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|120|Lobbed and rolling seed missile width (lobbed seed missile does not collide by itself)}}
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|5000|Lobbed missile speed}}|{{tt|1400|Rolling missile speed}}}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|150|Detonation radius, estimated}} <!--/ {{tt|X|Explosion Cone's Radius}}-->
|angle        = <!--X-->
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|projectile   = special
|spelleffects = aoe
|spellshield  = special
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Swirlseed's'' origin is determined from '''Lillia's''' position at the start of cast, the rolling direction is determined from '''Lillia's''' position at the end of cast (when the projectile is created, not when the seed starts rolling).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent the seed from detonating thus striking nearby targets.
* {{tip|Projectile|Projectile destroying effects}} will still make the rolling seed detonate upon colliding with them, but not when the initial arcing missile is destroyed.
** If {{cai|Unbreakable|Braum}} blocks the initial projectile, it is destroyed and deals 0 damage to him, as well as not triggering the cone-shaped area of effect.
* The spot at which the seed will collide with terrain is highlighted while it is rolling.
[[File: Swirlseed collision indicator.png|175px|thumb|left|Collision indicator]]
}}

R.name: Lilting Lullaby
R.title: Template:Data Lillia/Lilting Lullaby
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Lilting Lullaby|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lillia
|skill        = R
|icon         = Lilting Lullaby.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lillia}} casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', making them {{tip|drowsy}} before falling {{tip|asleep}} for a few seconds.
|blurb2      = Damaging {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} targets consumes the debuff to deal additional {{as|magic damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', which {{tt|arrives after {{fd|0.3}} seconds|fixed travel time missile}} and renders them {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 10%. After the duration, they fall {{tip|asleep}} for 2 seconds.
|icon2        = Lilting Lullaby 2.png
|description2 = The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage that a {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target takes from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} consumes the debuff to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|description3 = ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} is required to cast this ability. '''Lillia''' can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.''
|cost         = 50
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|150 to 110}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.4}}
|target range = {{tt|Global|or 19500}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.05}}
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = special
|spelleffects = spell
|projectile   = true
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}} nor block the wake-up damage.
** The lullaby's {{tip|drowsy}} application will be blocked.
* The additional {{as|magic damage}} dealt is accredited to '''Lillia''' and benefits from her {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
* ''Lilting Lullaby's'' missile will not hit a target that becomes {{tip|untargetable}} during the cast time or while it is travelling, or is in another realm.
* ''Lilting Lullaby's'' application does not trigger aggro from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, only its triggering damage does.
** {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust's}} persistent damage will still cause '''Lillia''' to trigger turret aggro, unless she casts ''Lilting Lullaby'' right before it runs out.
* {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} will mark targets if ''Lilting Lullaby'' is learned.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Lillia_Original_R_0.ogg}} ''"Sleepy time!"''
}}
